scope: Separate opt-in scorer and CLI; replay the existing source pack through the unchanged PR102 loader; distinct result revision and bindings; no default change or acquisition.

metric.offset_sign: source_minus_query_semitones; add this offset to query MIDI to align to source
metric.offset: For each candidate native window, mean(source_midi-query_midi) over jointly voiced frames, clipped to [-12,+12]. This is deterministic alignment, not supervised fitting.
metric.distance: Mean over ALL query frames: squared(source_midi-query_midi-offset) if both voiced;144 if voicing disagrees;0 if both unvoiced.
metric.arithmetic: Float64 direct nonnegative costs in bounded chunks. Offset uses float64 sum of jointly voiced differences divided by joint count; then clip; distance uses float64 sum of per-frame costs divided by query length. No FFT, cancellation-based variance formula, learned normalization, tempo change, resampling or parameter sweep.
metric.support: Preserve query voiced>=25% and candidate joint>=75% of query voiced using integer comparisons; no distance-based acceptance claim.
metric.ranking: Preserve nearest1e-8 semitone-squared integer ticks, ties-to-even; earliest frame within track; global ticks/nativeID/frame. Offset does not break ties.
metric.timing: Preserve native256/44100 absolute source grid and relative query grid with5microsecond tolerance. Preserve PR102 f0 bounds and explicit zero/unvoiced handling.

retained_query_validation.base_queries: All18 eligible fixed862-frame center queries in the existing frozen24-nomination order; all unavailable source outcomes retained.
retained_query_validation.transform: Retain every observed timestamp. Leave zero f0 zero; multiply every positive f0 by2**(shift/12). No clipping, interpolation or resampling. Reject and retain an explicit reason if a transformed positive f0 becomes nonpositive, nonfinite or exceeds20000Hz; never replace a query.
retained_query_validation.independent_oracle: First3 eligible base queries in frozen order, each at all3 shifts, against every18 usable native sources:162 planned track outcomes. Independent stdlib pitch conversion/scalar positive-cost arithmetic; independently establish minima and tie order. No project scorer imports.
retained_query_validation.baseline_regression: Replay all18 original queries through unchanged PR102 loader/scorer and require byte-identical saved baseline results and CLI compatibility. Recheck original code/source/query pins before and after.

cases: independent scalar costs, offset signs and clipping
unvoiced masks and exact support boundaries
constant/ambiguous contours and earliest quantized ties
positive tiny cost tied with exact zero
new caller input and ndarray/list parity without mutation
strict input schemas, physical pins and output freshness

No annotation or human judgment fabrication.
